# Load packages



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, tsibble, feasts, fable, seasonal)
```
:::



# Load data



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_data <- read_csv(
  "data/visitor_arrivals_by_air.csv")
```
:::



We noticed that Month-Year is in char format.

# Encode data into correct format



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_data$`Month-Year` <- dmy(
  ts_data$`Month-Year`)
```
:::




# Convert into time series data frame



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_data_ts <- ts(ts_data)       
head(ts_data_ts)
```

# Convert into tsibble dataframe, then can be used by R.



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_tsibble <- ts_data %>%
  mutate(Month = yearmonth(`Month-Year`)) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = `Month`)
```
:::



# Organise the data frame from wide to long format.



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_longer <- ts_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:34),
               names_to = "Country",
               values_to = "Arrivals")
```
:::



# Visualising time-series



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Month-Year`, 
             y = Arrivals))+
  geom_line(size = 0.5)+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format())
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_ex7_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(data = ts_longer, 
       aes(x = `Month-Year`, 
           y = Arrivals))+
  geom_line(size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Country,
             ncol = 3,
             scales = "free_y")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_ex7_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


# Cycle plot


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tsibble_longer <- ts_tsibble %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:34),
               names_to = "Country",
               values_to = "Arrivals")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam" |
         Country == "Italy") %>% 
  autoplot(Arrivals) + 
  facet_grid(Country ~ ., scales = "free_y")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_ex7_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-10-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam" |
         Country == "Italy") %>% 
  gg_subseries(Arrivals)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_ex7_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-11-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


# ACF



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(`Country` == "Vietnam" |
         `Country` == "Italy" |
         `Country` == "United Kingdom" |
         `Country` == "China") %>%
  ACF(Arrivals) %>%
  autoplot()
```
